title: Write end-to-end tests for auth flow, tenant onboarding, and isolation
acceptance_criteria: Cypress or Playwright configured for E2E testing
E2E test: user signup → tenant onboarding → dashboard loads with correct tenant context
E2E test: user login → upload resume → see analysis results on dashboard
E2E test: Tenant A cannot access Tenant B's resumes via URL manipulation
E2E test: password reset flow from email link to new password
E2E test: GDPR consent banner interaction (accept, reject, customize)
Tests run in headless mode as part of CI pipeline
